help.short: Optional. Specify the snapshot time to lease a snapshot.
The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.

The name of the file share within the specified storage account. File share names must be between 3 and 63 characters in length and use numbers, lower-case letters and dash (-) only. Every dash (-) character must be immediately preceded and followed by a letter or number.
Specifies the lease action. Can be one of the available actions.
Optional. For a break action, proposed duration the lease should continue before it is broken, in seconds, between 0 and 60.
Required for acquire. Specifies the duration of the lease, in seconds, or negative one (-1) for a lease that never expires.
Identifies the lease. Can be specified in any valid GUID string format.
Optional for acquire, required for change. Proposed lease ID, in a GUID string format.

description: The Lease Share operation establishes and manages a lock on a share for delete operations. The lock duration can be 15 to 60 seconds, or can be infinite.

operations.description: The Lease Share operation establishes and manages a lock on a share for delete operations. The lock duration can be 15 to 60 seconds, or can be infinite.

props.description: Specifies the lease action. Can be one of the available actions.
props.name: action

props.description: Optional. For a break action, proposed duration the lease should continue before it is broken, in seconds, between 0 and 60.
props.name: breakPeriod

props.description: Required for acquire. Specifies the duration of the lease, in seconds, or negative one (-1) for a lease that never expires.
props.name: leaseDuration

props.description: Identifies the lease. Can be specified in any valid GUID string format.
props.name: leaseId

props.description: Optional for acquire, required for change. Proposed lease ID, in a GUID string format.
props.name: proposedLeaseId

params.description: Optional. Specify the snapshot time to lease a snapshot.

params.description: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.
params.name: accountName

params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The name of the file share within the specified storage account. File share names must be between 3 and 63 characters in length and use numbers, lower-case letters and dash (-) only. Every dash (-) character must be immediately preceded and followed by a letter or number.
